sources.excerpt: After two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S to universal critical acclaim.
Grand Theft Auto VI sold 32.5 million preorder copies and generated US$3.79 billion within 24 hours of its release, making it the largest entertainment launch in history.

This made it the most preordered video game of all time, surpassing the previous record of 8 million copies held by Cyberpunk 2077. Approximately 75% of preorders were made for PlayStation 5, while the remaining 25% were for Xbox Series X/S.
Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh is a Mongolian politician who served as the country's sixth president from 2021 to 2026.
His resignation was accepted (96–8) by the State Great Khural on 19 November 2026, formally relieving him of his presidential duties.
Under Mongolian law, the parliament's speaker, Sandagiin Byambatsogt (MPP), assumed the presidential duties as acting officeholder until a new president is elected and inaugurated within four months.

The State Great Khural accepts the resignation of Mongolian president Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh. The chamber's chairman, Sandagiin Byambatsogt, assumes the acting presidency until a new election is held within four months.
To manufacture the bricks, the team used a 3D printing technique known as laser powder bed fusion.

Unlike Earth's soil, lunar regolith contains no organic material. Instead, it is made up of sharp, irregular fragments produced by billions of years of impacts from asteroids, micrometeorites, and other debris striking the Moon.

The University of Arkansas team demonstrated a different approach. Using a relatively low-power light source, they became the first researchers to directly fuse simulated lunar regolith into interlocking, reconfigurable construction blocks without adding a binding agent.
